pool.text: William Tucker built a house at Murderers Beach as the first European settler.
The Lay Association of the Free Church of Scotland established a Scottish settlement.
The London-owned Bank of Otago opened its doors in Dunedin.
Dunedin became New Zealand's first city by growth of population.
The Union Company shipping line was founded in Dunedin by James Mills.
The Main South Line connected the city with Christchurch.
The frozen meat industry was inaugurated with the first shipment from Port Chalmers.
British royals the Duke and Duchess of Cornwall and York toured Dunedin.
Mercy Hospital opened as a private non-profit hospital.
Television broadcasts began in Dunedin with the launch of channel DNTV2.
William Mason's Stock exchange was demolished as part of a reaction against Victorianism.
The city was designated as a UNESCO City of Literature.
The Cadbury Chocolate Factory and Cadbury World closed down.
Waikouaiti and Karitane reported high lead levels in their water supplies.
